name: 18-kite-robot
notes: Kite robot (hy3d, 50k tris). The diamond sheet is tilted ~45 deg (top at the back, z 0.05; bottom at the front, z 0.48) and is the hard body. Head: a feathered sphere over the top of the diamond, smooth, so a yaw bends the top instead of tearing it. Tail: the red ribbon from the sheet's lower-left (0.35,0.45,0.40) curling forward to the bow on the floor (0.12,0.02,0.88), a 4-bone smooth chain with capsules plus a sphere for the bow. Thin arms hang behind the lower fins from (0.29,0.47,0.22) and (0.72,0.47,0.23) to hands at y 0.28; smooth capsules so the shoulder blends into the sheet. Legs, feet, fins, spars and bridle stay with the body. Derived from vertex clusters, 2026-10-02.
